fault_notes: The agent handles the house move and broadband transfer professionally, verifies the customer's identity, confirms the new address and move date, and explains the transfer arrangements. The agent fails to use the required closing phrase, "Thank you for choosing S-Net", at the end of the call.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Thank you for calling S-Net. You're speaking with Hannah. How can I help you today?

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Hi, Hannah. I'm moving house next month, and I need to arrange for my broadband to be transferred to the new place.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Of course. I can help you arrange the move and check what services are available at your new address.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Lovely. I'm hoping it's fairly straightforward because I really don't want to be without internet while I'm settling in.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: I completely understand. We'll look at the dates and availability first, then go through any changes to your current package.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Okay, great. I'm moving on the fourteenth of November, so I'd ideally like the internet working that day.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Thanks, Mei. Before I access your account, could I confirm your full name and the first line of your current address?

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: It's Mei Chen, and I'm currently at 42 Willow Road.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Thank you. Could you also confirm the four-digit security PIN registered on your account?

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Yes, it's 7319.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Perfect, that's verified. I'll bring up your current package and check the details for the move.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Thanks. I've got broadband and the landline with you at the moment, although I hardly ever use the landline.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: That's useful to know. I'll check both services and make sure we understand what you want to carry over.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: I definitely want the broadband. I'm not sure about the landline, though. I might keep it if it doesn't cost much.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: No problem. We can review that separately. First, could you give me the full postcode and address of the new property?

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: It's 16 Birch Close, Flat 2, in Reading. The postcode is RG1 6AB.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Thank you, Mei. I'll check whether the address is serviceable and what connection options are available there.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: The previous tenant said they had broadband, so I'm hoping that means the connection is already there.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: That could help, although I'll need to confirm the actual service availability rather than assume it's ready to use.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Yes, that's fair. I just don't want to arrive with boxes everywhere and then find out there's no internet.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Absolutely. I'll check the address now and see whether we can arrange a transfer without needing a new installation.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Brilliant. Do you need anything else from me while you're checking?

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Not at the moment. I'll check the property details and the earliest available transfer date.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Okay. My current tenancy ends on the thirteenth, and I'll be collecting the new keys that morning.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: That's helpful. So you're moving on the fourteenth, with access to the new property from the thirteenth. Is that correct?

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Yes, exactly. I'll probably start moving things over that afternoon.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Great. I'll use the fourteenth as your requested service date, subject to the available transfer arrangements.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: That sounds good. Would I have to pay anything just to move the service?

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: I'll check the transfer terms on your account. Any installation or activation charges depend on the type of connection the new property needs.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Right. I thought moving an existing service was usually free, so I don't want any surprises on the bill.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: That's a reasonable concern. I'll explain any confirmed costs before we submit the request, so you can decide with the full information.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Thanks. I'd much rather know now than see a random charge next month.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Of course. I'm checking the connection type and the transfer conditions together.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: One other thing, will I need to send my router back and get a different one?

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Usually, you can take your existing router with you if the new connection supports it. I'll confirm that for the service available at your new address.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Good, because it's only about a year old, and I'd rather not replace it unnecessarily.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: That makes sense. I'll include the equipment question in the checks before finalising the transfer.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: How long does the actual transfer usually take? Is it just a switch on the day?

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: If the property already has a compatible connection, it can be fairly straightforward. If an engineer is needed, we'll arrange an appointment and confirm the timing.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: I work from home three days a week, so an engineer appointment would need a bit of planning.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Understood. If an appointment is required, I'll check the available slots with you before anything is booked.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Okay, that's reassuring. I can take a day off if I know in advance, but it would be difficult at short notice.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: I'll bear that in mind. The aim is to give you a clear plan and avoid unnecessary disruption.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Have you found anything yet? Sorry, I'm just a little anxious about the timing.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: No need to apologise. I understand that having internet ready is important when you're moving, especially when you work from home.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Exactly. I can manage a day or two, but not a whole week without it.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: I've confirmed that the new address is within our service area. I'm checking the specific connection details now to determine the next step.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: That's good news. Does that mean I can keep my current broadband package?

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: The address supports a broadband service, and your current package appears eligible for transfer. I'll check the speed and any equipment requirements before confirming.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: My current package is the 150 megabit one. I'd prefer to keep that if it's available.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: I'll check that package against the new property's connection. If it isn't available, I'll explain the alternatives rather than change it without your agreement.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: That's fair. I don't need anything faster, really. I just need it to be reliable.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Understood. I'll prioritise keeping your existing package if the property supports it and check the monthly price as well.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Thank you. And what happens to the billing date? Will I get charged twice during the move?

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: The transfer should remain under your existing account, so you wouldn't normally need a second broadband subscription. I'll explain any adjustments shown on the order before submitting it.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Okay, that helps. I've already got enough moving expenses to think about without paying two broadband bills.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: I can imagine. I'll make sure the account details and the transfer date are correct so the billing can be handled properly.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: What about the landline? If I keep it, will the number come with me?

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: That depends on the available telephone service at the new address and the transfer process. I'll check whether your current number can be retained before making any changes.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: I don't use it often, but my mum still calls that number sometimes, so I'd rather keep it if possible.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: That makes sense. I'll check the number-transfer options and make sure we don't disconnect anything prematurely.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Great. I was worried the landline would just get cancelled as soon as I moved.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: I'll make a note that retaining the number is your preference. We'll confirm the options before completing that part of the request.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: All right. Are we nearly ready to arrange the move, then?

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Yes, I've got the key details. I'll summarise the request with you now and confirm the date and the outstanding checks.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Okay. The move date is the fourteenth of November, and the new address is 16 Birch Close, Flat 2.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Correct. I'll record the fourteenth of November as your requested transfer date, with the new address and your preference to retain the current broadband package.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: And I want to keep the landline number if that's possible, but I don't want the landline added at a higher price without checking first.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Understood. I'll note that number retention is preferred, and that you want the cost confirmed before agreeing to any landline changes.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Perfect. Is there anything I need to do before moving day?

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Keep your router and its power cable with you, and don't cancel the existing service separately. We'll handle the transfer through this request.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: That's useful. I'll pack the router separately so I don't lose it among all the boxes.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Good idea. Once the transfer arrangements are confirmed, you'll receive the details about the service date and any appointment that may be required.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Okay, that's clear. I just want to be sure this has actually been recorded and isn't only a note on the account.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: That's a fair question. I've saved the move details and submitted the transfer request for the service team to finalise the connection arrangements.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Good, thank you. Will I get an email confirming everything?

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Yes, we'll send the confirmation to the email address registered on your account, including the next steps and any details that still need to be finalised.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Brilliant. I'll keep an eye out for that. Thanks for explaining it all without making it too complicated.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: You're very welcome, Mei. Just to confirm, we've recorded your requested move date, saved the new address, and submitted the transfer request. Is there anything else you'd like me to check?

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: No, that's everything for now. I feel much better knowing the request is in and I'll get the confirmation.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: I'm glad I could help. Thanks for taking the time to go through the details with me, and I hope the move goes smoothly.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Thank you, Hannah. Have a lovely day.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: You too, Mei. Take care, and I hope everything goes well at the new place.
